description: Object type with only the keys `K` of `T`. `K` must be real keys of `T`.
Object type with every key of `T` except `K`. `K` is not checked against `keyof T`, so typos pass silently.
`Omit` on a union keeps only the keys common to all members. Use a distributive conditional type to omit per member.
`const { secret, ...rest } = value` copies every property except `secret` into a new object.
